pipeline.title: NIOS Grid (gm + ni admin/discovery fields)
pipeline.description: Lightweight field extraction for the NIOS GM (admin login/logout) and Network Insight (subprocess + summary task) streams, so the Infoblox Operations dashboard can slice on gm_event / gm_user / gm_login_src and ni_module / ni_summary / ni_scan_op without doing full-text matching every time. Connect to streams 'NIOS (gm.darknetian.com)' and 'NIOS (ni.darknetian.com)'.

rules.title: gm extract admin event
rules.description: NIOS GM httpd admin events look like: 'httpd: 2026-05-15 17:06:22.185Z [admin]: Login_Allowed - - to=AdminConnector ip=10.10.0.7'. Pulls out the user (in brackets), the event verb after the colon, and the source ip= field.

rules.title: ni extract module + summary
rules.description: Network Insight syslog looks like: 'gunicorn: ni:netauto_core[414062]: consolidate.pl: [414062] Wireless Summary: Processed' or 'ni:netauto_discovery[6026]: dataProc.pl: 06026 (worker01) 10.10.0.172/WirelessObject'. Pulls out the NI module (netauto_core / netauto_discovery / sudo / scriptxmld) and, when present, the consolidate-summary type (Wireless / Topology / Routing / etc.) or the discovery target IP + scan op.
